searchText: Hey, I would like to ask in which order the different validator indexes that have been submitted to the BLSToExecutionChange pool will be processed. I am asking because I would like to understand better when validators can expect their first withdrawals after submitting the credential change. Is the following correct? ~533916 active validators ~58% have 0x00 credentials ~~7200~~ 115200 validators/day can change from 0x00 to 0x01 (16 validators every 12 seconds (per block)) 👉 533916 validators * 0.58 / (~~7200~~ 115200 validators/day) = ~~43~~ 4.6 days. So 43 days worst case after submitting the signature. But are the indexes processed in a certain order, e.g., starting with 0 or in random order? > 7200 validators/day can change from 0x00 to 0x01 (16 validators every 12 seconds (per block)) That's out by a factor of 32, it's 16 * (86400/12) = 115,200 Ordering of change credentials operations on-chain isn't related to validator index. ah, forgot to multiply by 16 👌 And what determines the order? Each block will contain operations based on what is in the pool of the beacon node proposing it, the order of arrival of those operations at the node, and the process used by the beacon node to select the operations from the pool. Some beacon nodes were going to be last in first out, but I'm not sure which ones actually implemented that. Others may be first in first out, or random, or... it isn't defined in the spec so up to the individual client teams to pick whatever method they wish. Thank you 👌 For reference Lighthouse is LIFO, and I think Prysm, Lodestar, Nimbus and Teku are too (pretty sure about Prysm and Nimbus) LIFO disincentivises spamming at the fork The above is correct, Prysm is LIFO .
